note: USFS (Flathead NF, Spotted Bear RD) campground on the Spotted Bear River near the south end of Hungry Horse Reservoir, reached via ~63 mi of gravel East Side Reservoir Rd #38 + Rd #568; sites in old growth, set back from the road and less than 100 ft from the river. Usually has open sites midweek; busy with fall hunters and with stock users when the Silvertip Trailhead is closed. No cell service; Rd 38 (mileposts 37-53) and all of Rd 568 have a winter wildlife closure 12/1 - 5/14. --Claude
summary: Flathead NF page (FS-run, Spotted Bear RD): confirmed free, 4 units, trailers to 32 ft, vault toilet. Added no potable water, season May 15 - Nov 30, 16-day limit. The page does not say how sites are taken (derived FCFS left as is). No alert for the campground or its roads (the Camp Creek Fire closure covers trails only). Note trimmed of restated values; access caveats added from the page.
